messages:
anya: Heads up — mini-canary on quant8 bring-up shows ~6% drop on intent recall for the 'search paraphrase' promptset vs q4b baseline. I sampled 200 canary requests, 20% flagged low-confidence. Need quick resample + golden checks. Anyone available to coordinate labeler run? :eyes:

matt: I'm on it. Can we restrict to short ctx (<512) and high-entropy bucket? Those seem worst.

sophia: I can spin up the labeler batch. What's the exact query? 

anya: Use this SQL-ish sampler: 

```
SELECT id, prompt, model_score, entropy
FROM canary_requests
WHERE model_variant = 'quant8-canary'
  AND seq_len < 512
  AND entropy > 1.2
ORDER BY rand()
LIMIT 500;
```

Labelers: please mark correctness + severity (0/1/2). We'll use golden rules from /docs/golden-guidelines v2.

labeler-bot: @labeler-team new job created: `mini-canary-quant8-resample-170555` — 500 items, due EOD tomorrow. Link: https://labeler.internal/jobs/170555

jordan: I'll take priority QC on the first 50. Planning to run A/B diffs vs q4b baseline after labels in the eval harness.

matt: timeline? If we can get labels in 12h we can re-run the canary metrics and decide rollback or mitigation (fallback routing to q4b).

sophia: assigning 10 labelers now. ETA 10-12h. I'll add a "possible hallucination" flag in the UI.

anya: thanks. If labelers hit ambiguous cases, tag with `#ambig-quant` and ping me. Also: do not include any PII in golden exports — scrub via `tools/scrub_export --redact` before uploading to s3.

labeler-bot: Note: job `mini-canary-quant8-resample-170555` auto-splits into 5 batches.

jordan: got first 50 labels. prepping A/B probe run. will share heatmap in ~1h.

anya: appreciate it. let's avoid over-sampling paraphrase duplicates — use the dedupe score > 0.7 cutoff.

sophia: yep dedupe param set: `min_hash_similarity = 0.7` in sampler.

matt: if anything looks like systematic tokenization drift, flag `#tokenizer-drift` and we'll run tokenizer-compare on samples.

jordan: first run: recall drop 5.8% on sampled set, avg severity +0.34. sharing raw: https://internal/plots/canary/170555

anya: ouch. ok hold on routing change. sophia/matt agree to open rollback window of 2h?

matt: agreed. opening rollback to q4b for canary traffic now. documenting in rollout log: `/rollouts/quant8-canary/170555.md`

sophia: labelers continuing. I'll attach flagged examples to the ticket.

labeler-bot: job complete. 500 labeled, 5 flagged #ambig-quant, 12 flagged #tokenizer-drift.

jordan: final A/B: recall drop 5.4%, severe errors concentrated in rare-terms cluster. recommend postpone quant8 until quant-tune + retrain calibration. Filing eval ticket: EV-170555.

anya: thanks everyone. postmortem/next steps in #eng-ml tomorrow. For now rollback remains and I'll coordinate with runtime to rerun quant kernel selection tests.

sophia: noted, will also add a small unit test in canary harness to surface rarer cluster coverage automatically.

matt: tl;dr — resample + labeler run confirmed regression; rolled back. follow-ups: quant-tune, tokenization compare, test for rare clusters.

anya: :thumbsup:
